name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-AMOLED-1.91 / ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.91 (V1 board)
description: 1.91" 240x536 AMOLED (RM67162, QSPI), FT3168 touch, QMI8658C, battery sense.
verify: Pins from Waveshare's demo code and schematic (https://github.com/waveshareteam/ESP32-S3-AMOLED-1.91). 1) TF card: no conflict on this revision - the schematic and the code's V1 branch agree (SPI, SCK 47, MOSI 42, MISO 8, CS 9). The code's DEFAULT is the other board (VersionControl_V2: SDMMC, CLK 9, CMD 42, D0 8), so the vendor's examples as downloaded do not mount a card on a V1 board until that macro is commented out. The glass has rounded corners whose radius Waveshare does not give, so the designer draws them square: keep what matters out of the corners, or set a corner radius on the Display tab once it is measured. On the board and not in this preset: TF card: it is wired onto the panel's own SPI lines, which the export gives to the panel alone. Brightness is a command to the panel, not a backlight pin. Compiled; not run on a board here.
